snippet.description:
Zakhmi parinda hai.. 
Phir bhi tu zinda hai.. 
Maanle kehna mera..❤️ 

Tune into ‘Tera Mera Rishta Continues (Film Ballad) from ‘Awarapan 2’. A heartfelt melody about love, hope, and never giving up, this beautiful track is recreated and rearranged by Mithoon. With lyrics by Sayeed Quadri and vocals by Saaj Bhatt and Subodhh Sharma, the original song is composed by Mustafa Zahid with music by Pritam. It features Emraan Hashmi and Disha Patani in the video.
